visualCharacteristics.purpose: Single lazy-loaded third-party video player (Wistia, YouTube, Vimeo)
visualCharacteristics.description: Single centered 16:9 video player (about 10/12 of the content width on desktop, full width on mobile). Third-party iframe (Wistia by default) lazy-loaded when near the viewport; with an optional poster image it shows the poster with a play button and loads the player on click.

contentPattern.structure: One row: optional poster image, then a link to the video URL (https://fast.wistia.net/embed/iframe/<mediaId>, a wistia.com/medias/<id> URL, YouTube or Vimeo URL)

reuseGuidance: Use for a single embedded third-party video player. Put the section heading/intro as default content above the block.
